prompt:
LAYOUT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT. A 2D game character sprite sheet laid out as a STRICT RECTANGULAR GRID of 6 columns by 5 rows = 30 poses. Every pose in its own cell, all cells the SAME SIZE, evenly spaced, aligned in straight rows and columns. WIDE EMPTY BLACK GAPS between cells. NO grid lines drawn, NO borders, NO ground lines, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO dividing rules. Do NOT stagger poses, do NOT arrange along an arc, do NOT let poses touch or overlap.

SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT CONSISTENCY RULE: this is ONE character drawn 30 times. His PROPORTIONS MUST BE IDENTICAL IN EVERY CELL — the same head size relative to his body, the same shoulder width, the same limb thickness, the same total height when standing upright. He must never look chunkier in one pose and slimmer in another. Draw him as if tracing the same model, changing only the pose.

THE CHARACTER, identical in all 30 cells, side profile facing RIGHT unless a pose says otherwise: a lean athletic cyberpunk death god.
- A bright red #E01F26 hannya oni mask covering the ENTIRE face, narrow white glowing eye slits, a fanged white grin, a small cyan third eye on the forehead.
- Two red horns swept BACKWARD from the temples, never up or forward.
- A very long ponytail banded deep indigo #1E33D9 at the root through electric blue #2B6FE8 to bright cyan #35C6F4 at the tip.
- A BROAD PURE WHITE SLEEVELESS captain's haori with a torn ragged hem.
  THE HAORI IS THE MOST IMPORTANT GARMENT AND THE ONE MOST OFTEN FORGOTTEN. It must be LARGE, WHITE and UNMISTAKABLE in ALL 30 CELLS WITHOUT EXCEPTION. He never takes it off. He does not remove it to run, to fight, to jump, to fall or to kneel. When he runs it STREAMS OUT BEHIND HIM as a big white shape — it does not disappear. A cell without a large white haori is a FAILED cell.
- A black tracksuit jacket with acid-green #C6F02A and cyan racing stripes. The SLEEVES ARE ROLLED TO THE ELBOWS: below the elbow his BARE FOREARMS AND HANDS are DEEP BROWN SKIN (#855434 base, #4A2A1A shadow, #B07A4A highlight). He is a Black man. Forearms and hands must be BROWN SKIN — never dark fabric, never grey, never pale, never gloved.
- Black hakama trousers gathered at the ankles, black tabi boots.
- A katana and wakizashi in black scabbards at his LEFT hip.

THE 30 POSES, reading left to right, top to bottom:
ROW 1 — IDLE, 6 frames: a subtle breathing loop, standing relaxed, swords sheathed, ponytail drifting slightly. He barely moves; only the chest, shoulders and hair.
ROW 2 — RUN, 6 frames. THE WHITE HAORI MUST BE IN ALL SIX OF THESE CELLS, streaming out behind him as a large white shape. Do NOT draw him running without the haori. A symmetrical run cycle. 1 right foot contact ahead, 2 weight down knee bent, 3 legs passing under the hips, 4 left foot contact ahead, 5 weight down, 6 legs passing. Haori and ponytail stream behind.
ROW 3 — JUMP AND FALL, 6 frames: 1 crouched coiling, 2 launching body stretched tall hair whipped down, 3 rising knees tucked, 4 apex compact, 5 falling legs trailing hair streaming up, 6 landing knees deeply bent.
ROW 4 — KATANA ATTACK, 6 frames. THE WHITE HAORI MUST BE IN ALL SIX. Every cell must contain a drawn character — do not leave any cell empty. 1 blade cocked back over the shoulder, 2 windup peak torso rotated away, 3 torso snapping forward blade starting to travel, 4 mid swing with a SHORT COMPACT acid-green arc, 5 full extension front knee bent in a lunge, 6 recovery blade lowered. Keep every arc INSIDE its own cell.
ROW 5 — REACTIONS, 6 frames: 1 crouching low, 2 dashing with the body pitched forward and legs streaming back, 3 knocked backward in pain, 4 falling defeated, 5 lying face down on the ground, 6 kneeling in prayer with head bowed.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels on a consistent grid, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. 16-bit Castlevania Symphony of the Night style.

BACKGROUND: PURE BLACK #000000 everywhere.

STRICT PALETTE — ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568 #4A2A1A #855434 #B07A4A.

FINAL CHECK before you finish: count the cells. There must be 30 cells and EVERY SINGLE ONE must contain the character wearing his large white haori. No empty cells. No cells without the haori.
